isd.text: Saint Traft hunts demons along the Ashmouth with Avacyn's angels and is recognized as a saint before his fortieth year, which leads the demons to plot revenge on him.
He returns home to find his wards scratched out and a bloody message demanding he come without angels, along with a girl's finger, so he lies to the angel to save the child and rides to Needle's Eye.

When the cult-priest threatens to kill the possessed girl if he calls angels, Traft fights blind in a black fog, only to discover he was tricked into killing with the cult-priest's bone dagger, doing a demon's bidding; he then frees the girl and sends her home.
Withengar rises from the crack in the earth, and although Traft finally calls on the angels, the demon destroys him, and he never enters the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist haunting the world.
